rows.en: Ymir: "...Any response?"
Sisk: "No..."
Kasumi: "Touya..."
Miyasco: "Oh! Vorlia has started collapsing!"
Aurelie: "They still aren't back...?"
Celica: "..."
Xiujian: "...That's as long as we can wait."
Fain: "!? Y-you..."
Xiujian: "It's dangerous to remain here any longer."
Fain: "Are you going to abandon them?!
You bastard, do you call yourself a comrade?!"
Xiujian: "..."
Fain: "!! Say something..."
Celica: "Fain, stop!"
Fain: "Princess, don't stop me!
A bastard like this..."
Celica: "Idiot!"
Fain: "P-Princess...?"
Celica: "Do you think he's saying this without a care?!
You aren't the only one who's hurting!"
Fain: "...!! Xiujian... You...
Your hand is bleeding..."
Xiujian: "...It's nothing serious."
Fain: "...I'm sorry...
It's just as painful for you, isn't it...?"
Xiujian: "...Don't worry about it."
Clovis: "Ymir."
Ymir: "...Liebhofen will now leave
this airspace... Captain, is that all right?"
Captain Roa: "...Yes."
Baren: "...Liebhofen, departing."
Kasumi: "Touya..."
Melvi: "Hey, Touya and the others... They'll come back, right?"
Ymir: "Of course.
Those two would never let that happen.
It'll be all right... They'll come back... They will..."
Teacher: "...is... still... but...
Koichiro: "...ouya... Hey, Touya...
You shouldn't be sleeping on the very first day... Hey..."
Teacher: "..."
Koichiro: "...H-hey, Touya! You're in trouble..."
Koichiro: "The teacher's coming this way... Hey, Touya...
...Well, don't say I didn't warn you..."
????? (...I finally found you...)
Touya: "?!"
Woman: "Touya Kazami..."
Touya: "...Th-this is... the classroom?"
Woman: "Yes... Welcome home, Touya."
Touya: "...O-oh. I'm home."
Touya: "Wenimas...
Hey, what's going on?
Was I... Was everything that happened just a dream?"
Wenimas: "No. It was all real.
And thanks to what you did, Vorlia was destroyed."
Touya: "Destroyed... So we won?"
Wenimas: "Yes."
Touya: "I see... We won..."
Wenimas: "Thank you.
Thanks to you, Agarthia... No,
this world was saved too..."
Touya: "I didn't do it on my own.
Everyone's feelings made it possible.
All the comrades I believe in."
Wenimas: "Hehehe... You're right."
Touya: "Anyway, what the hell's going on here?
This looks just like it did before I went to Agarthia..."
Wenimas: "No time has passed
in this world."
Touya: "...What do you mean?"
Wenimas: "All the places you've been in until now
are 'parallel universes.'
You've come back from there to your original universe."
Touya: "Parallel universes?"
Wenimas: "Their existence explains quantum paradoxes.
The probabilistic fluctuations of the state vector are taken to mean
that 'every possible outcome' actually exists,
and that this universe is only one part
of a 'multidimensional universe,' an infinite-dimensional space.
It isn't a matter of physical reality,
but merely the limits of our human subjectivity.
In other words, worlds exist there
that humans simply can't perceive."
Touya: "..."
Wenimas: "Hmm... Let's see..."
Touya: "No, that's enough.
Anyway, there are multiple worlds besides
the one I lived in, right?"
Wenimas: "W-well, yes, that's right."
Touya: "Then the world Kasumi was in
was another separate world too?"
Wenimas: "Yes. As I said,
there are as many worlds as there are possibilities
of what could happen in this world."
Touya: "Then Agarthia too..."
Wenimas: "No, that's a little different. In a parallel world,
there's always someone who's your counterpart.
But there wasn't anyone like that in Agarthia, was there?
That world lies between this world and another."
Touya: "...Just how much did you know...?"
Wenimas: "When I freed my consciousness,
perhaps I touched something you could call the will of the universe.
But I don't know what I can do,
or what powers I've gained.
When I wished with all my heart to save Agarthia,
I simply knew what I had to do.
And I acted accordingly.
In the end, that meant I used you all..."
Touya: "But if worlds exist for every possible outcome,
doesn't that mean you didn't need to do any of this?"
Wenimas: "No. Those worlds exist,
but each one is complete within itself.
So even if other worlds exist, what happens in each world
still accumulates as its own passage of time.
I only gathered helpers from other worlds
to save the world of Agarthia."
Touya: "So the Agarthia I was in
has started moving forward as the world
of the 'saved' outcome?"
Wenimas: "Yes. And you've returned
to the world where you originally belong."
Touya: "Then what happened to Melissa? To everyone?"
Wenimas: "It's all right. Melissa returned
to her original world too. Everyone else is safe as well."
Touya: "...I see...!!
H-hey... Don't tell me they weren't from this world,
but from another world..."
Wenimas: "Hehehe..."
Touya: "This isn't funny! If that's true,
wouldn't that mean the Melissa in this world knows nothing
about me?!"
Wenimas: "Hehehe... It's all right.
She's from this world. You needn't worry."
Touya: "R-right..."
Wenimas: "Oh... I'm sorry.
I have to be going soon..."
Touya: "...Going where?"
Wenimas: "To the one I love..."
Touya: "?"
Wenimas: "...Thank you, truly.
The world I loved was saved... And so was my beloved..."
Touya: "...I see. So this is goodbye."
Wenimas: "Yes. Well, then..."
Touya: "Yeah..."
Ayaka: "Good morning, Touya Kazami."
Touya: "Good morning, ma'am."
Ayaka: "...You're certainly brazen, aren't you?"
Touya: "I'm sorry. I'll be more careful from now on."
Ayaka: "R-right... Please do.
And next time, say that after you wake up."
Touya: "Oh..."
And so my battle ended.
The days I spent in Agarthia became precious memories,
<FC:5A:3E> and the people I met there became irreplaceable friends.
<FC:5A:3E> I don't know what became of everyone.
But surely their hearts are as bright and clear
<FC:5A:3E> as this blue sky...
<FC:5A:3E> Somehow, that was how I felt.
The familiar daily life starting again, and the new daily life beginning...
<FC:5A:3E> Even the things that bored me now seem to shine.
<FC:5A:3E> Because...
Yamato: "Morning, Touya!"
Touya: "O-oh... Morning."
Koichiro: "Good morning, Touya."
Touya: "Morning... Hey, what are you doing here?!"
Koichiro: "Well, let's not stand around talking. Let's sit down."
Kasumi: "Here you go."
Koichiro: "Oh, you needn't go to any trouble..."
Touya: "Aaargh! Don't make yourself at home in my house!"
Koichiro: "Why are you so grouchy?
You must be short of calcium.
They say people these days tend not to get enough."
Kasumi: "Now, now, it's all right, Touya.
Koichiro came because he was worried about you, you know?
Come on, sit down."
Touya: "O-oh..."
Yamato: "Honestly, don't eat with your elbows on the table, meow!"
Touya: "Yeah, yeah."
Yamato: "Don't hover your chopsticks over the dishes!"
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "Don't slurp your miso soup, meow!"
Touya: "Aaargh! Let me eat my meals how I like!"
Yamato: "No. The way you are now, I'd be too embarrassed
to let you eat in front of anyone else, meow."
Touya: "You're so damn noisy..."
Yamato: "What, meow?! Is that any way to talk?!"
Touya: "What?!"
Koichiro: "...To think you and Kasumi
went to another world...
To be honest, there are things I still can't quite believe,
but seeing Yamato talking like this
makes me feel it really happened."
Kasumi: "Hehehe... Yes. Touya and I
had a strange experience, but to everyone in this world,
it all happened in an instant."
Touya: "Yeah, that's just it.
You really didn't see Zeifon fighting in the schoolyard?"
Koichiro: "Why would I lie?
You came back on Friday, April 8.
First period on the first day of classes. I'm sure of that."
Kasumi: "It's strange. I didn't know about Zeifon
and Rayblade fighting in the schoolyard either..."
Koichiro: "So our memories became different on the day
you had that strange experience,
Friday, April 8. And you came back on that very same day...
Maybe the broken loop of time joined back together?
Still, giant robots... I wish I'd been chosen too...
Hey, can't we go there anymore?"
Kasumi: "There you go again...
Never mind that. Eat up before it gets cold."
Koichiro: "You're right. Today's breakfast matters more
than the past. Well, then, I'll get started
with this skewered dried fish... Here, Touya, open wide..."
Touya: "H-hey! Stop that!"
Koichiro: "Oh, what are you so embarrassed about?
We're close, aren't we, Touya...?"
Touya: "Don't start making up fantasies."
Koichiro: "H-how cruel... Was I... just a fling to you...?"
Touya: "...I'll hit you, you know?"
Koichiro: "Oh, it was just a little joke."
Touya: "...When you do it, it doesn't sound like a joke. So stop."
Kasumi: "All right, all right. Isn't that enough?
Today's an important day, isn't it, Touya?"
Touya: "Yeah..."
Kasumi: "Huh? Who could that be?"
Koichiro: "Were you expecting anyone besides us?"
Touya: "No."
Kasumi: "I'll go and see."
Touya: "No, I'll go. Kasumi, look after this guy
for me."
Koichiro: "Hey! You're treating me like a pet..."
Touya: "...Yes? Who is it?"
Touya: "?"
Touya: "!?"
Touya: "M-Melissa?!"
Melissa: "...Here I am."
Melissa: "...Hey, Touya."
Touya: "Hm?"
Melissa: "Then why don't we promise? That we'll definitely meet when we get back."
Touya: "Y-yeah... Of course."
Melissa: "It's a promise, all right?"
Touya: "Yeah. But how...?"
Melissa: "That's no problem. I've got a good idea."
Touya: "A-a good idea...?"
Melissa: "It's... a... secret.♥"
Touya: "You... That 'good idea' back then was..."
Melissa: "Hehehehe, it's a nice idea, isn't it?
...Anyway, I'll be staying with you for a while. Take good care of me, Touya."
Touya: "...Honestly."
Kasumi: "Touya, what's wrong... Oh!"
Melissa: "Oh! Kasumi, it's been ages!"
Kasumi: "Melissa?!"
Koichiro: "Oh, so this is Touya's sweeeet honey?"
Melissa: "My, he's quite handsome...
But he looks a little frivolous, doesn't he?"
Koichiro: "...What's she saying?"
Kasumi: "Huh? Y-yes... I think she's complimenting you...
She says you're good-looking."
Koichiro: "Oh, you're making me blush... Thank you, thank you!"
Touya: "...W-well, I've got rooms to spare,
so I don't mind, but how long can you stay?
Judging from that bag, three or four days?"
Melissa: "Oh, don't worry. My luggage will arrive later."
Touya: "...Huh?"
Kasumi: "U-um... Is this going to be a long stay, perhaps?"
Melissa: "Yes. I've come to Japan as an international student, actually."
Touya: "Huh? You... You're a student?"
Melissa: "Yes! To earn that merit-based recommendation,
I really worked hard, you know.
That's why I couldn't get in touch at all."
Touya: "You went that far..."
Melissa: "And once I was selected, I couldn't wait any longer,
so I came straight here.
I was in such a hurry, I put this outfit together from whatever I had..."
Kasumi: "But it really suits you. Doesn't it, Touya?"
Touya: "Y-yeah. It suits you. You've got pretty good taste."
Melissa: "Really?"
Touya: "W-what...?"
Melissa: "Hehehe, thank you.
Maybe that's why I chose you, Touya."
And so my battle ended.
The days I spent in Agarthia became precious memories,
<FC:5A:3E> and the people I met there became irreplaceable friends.
<FC:5A:3E> I don't know what became of everyone.
But surely their hearts are as bright and clear
<FC:5A:3E> as this blue sky...
<FC:5A:3E> Somehow, that was how I felt.
The familiar daily life starting again, and the new daily life beginning...
<FC:5A:3E> Even the things that bored me now seem to shine.
<FC:5A:3E> Now that I know how precious daily life is...
Reporter: "...We still have no firm explanation for
the mysterious pillars of light seen around the world the other day.
In particular, the fact that three pillars were seen in Japan
has strengthened the view that the key to the mystery lies here,
and a United Nations investigation team is being dispatched today.
The team is due to arrive tomorrow afternoon.
And now, the next story..."
